rows.label: bf06090100_0010
rows.name:
After fighting him several times,
I have come to understand.

rows.label: bf06090100_0020
rows.name:
Not once has he used his power
as Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf06090100_0030
rows.name: That is proof that he is malfunctioning.

rows.label: bf06090100_0040
rows.name:
You mean he can't use the
full extent of his powers?

rows.label: bf06090100_0050
rows.name:
The wounds I dealt in our battle long
ago may not be completely healed.

rows.label: bf06090100_0060
rows.name: His goal is Eden.

rows.label: bf06090100_0070
rows.name:
He wants to return to Eden, his
birthplace, and recover his own power.

rows.label: bf06090100_0080
rows.name: If Metsu regains his power...

rows.label: bf06090100_0090
rows.name:
The tragedy from 500
years ago will repeat

rows.label: bf06090100_0100
rows.name: More than that. Metsu is pure.

rows.label: bf06090100_0110
rows.name:
He means to destroy
humanity in its entirety.

rows.label: bf06090100_0120
rows.name: Why would anyone desire that?

rows.label: bf06090100_0130
rows.name: Perhaps he does not even have a reason.

rows.label: bf06090100_0140
rows.name:
Because it's his instinct,
as natural as breathing.

rows.label: bf06090100_0150
rows.name: This is also my responsibility.

rows.label: bf06090100_0160
rows.name: Your Holiness? Whatever do you mean?

rows.label: bf06090100_0170
rows.name:
It was none other than I who
brought Metsu into being.

rows.label: bf06090100_0180
rows.name:
So, Your Holiness... the rumor that
you were once Metsu's Driver is...

rows.label: bf06090100_0190
rows.name:
I never intended to obscure the truth. It is
writ plain for all to see in history books.

rows.label: bf06090100_0200
rows.name: I was a fool...

rows.label: bf06090100_0210
rows.name: So that no such fool would ever appear again,

rows.label: bf06090100_0220
rows.name:
after the Holy Grail War, passage to the World Tree
was forbidden.

rows.label: bf06090100_0230
rows.name:
But even if we forbid it,
it means nothing to Metsu and the others.

rows.label: bf06090100_0240
rows.name: [ML:undisp ][ML:Dash ][ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf06090100_0250
rows.name: The prohibition must be lifted now
